title: Cyber Operation: Phishing and scripting support
summary: OpenAI banned accounts involved in activity that overlapped with publicly reported threat groups and displayed hallmarks consistent with PRC intelligence requirements, using AI to support phishing and scripting workflows.
body: OpenAI banned accounts involved in activity that overlapped with publicly reported threat groups and displayed hallmarks consistent with PRC intelligence requirements, using AI to support phishing and scripting workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了部分与公开报道的威胁团体有重叠、符合情报需求特征的账户，它们利用AI工具来支持网络钓鱼和自动化脚本编写。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned accounts involved in activity that overlapped with publicly reported threat groups and displayed hallmarks consistent with PRC intelligence requirements, using AI to support phishing and scripting workflows.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Cyber Operation: Phishing and scripting support”。其重要性主要体现在：揭示了威胁组织将AI脚本生成能力应用于网络钓鱼活动的安全风险。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
